## player availability

Show player availability (injuries, suspensions, etc.)

```text
Usage: fplr player availability [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -t, --team <TEAM>          Filter by team name
  -n, --name <NAME>          Filter by player name
  -N, --news <NEWS>          Filter by news content
  -p, --position <POSITION>  Filter by position [possible values: goalkeeper, defender, midfielder, forward]
  -a, --all                  Show all players, not just those with issues
  -l, --limit <LIMIT>        Number of players to show [default: 20]
```

**Example**

```sh
fplr player availability -l 10
```


## player compare

Compare two players side-by-side

```text
Usage: fplr player compare [OPTIONS] <ID1> <ID2>

Arguments:
  <ID1>  First player ID
  <ID2>  Second player ID
```

**Example**

```sh
fplr player compare 411 379
```

## player list

```text
Usage: fplr player list [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -s, --sort <SORT>          [default: points] [possible values: cost, selected-by, form, minutes, goals-scored, assists, clean-sheets, goals-conceded, own-goals, penalties-saved, penalties-missed, yellow-cards, red-cards, saves, bonus, bps, influence, creativity, threat, ict-index, dream-team-count, value-form, value-season, points-per-game, expected-goals, expected-assists, expected-goal-involvements, expected-goals-conceded, starts, tackles, clearances-blocks-interceptions, recoveries, defensive-contribution, transfers-in, transfers-out, transfers-in-event, transfers-out-event, price-rise-event, price-rise-start, points]
```

## player trend

```text
Usage: fplr player trend [OPTIONS]

  -t, --team <TEAM>          Filter by team name
  -p, --position <POSITION>  Filter by position [possible values: goalkeeper, defender, midfielder, forward]
  -l, --limit <LIMIT>        Number of players to show [default: 20]
  -w, --weeks <WEEKS>        Number of recent gameweeks to show [default: 5]
      --min-cost <MIN_COST>
      --max-cost <MAX_COST>
```
